name: robots/tonyzhaozh__act
title: ACT bimanual ViperX insertion scene (MuJoCo model)
intro: ACT bimanual ViperX insertion scene (MuJoCo model), adapted from tonyzhaozh/act. It reads `time_ms`, `qpos`, `qvel`, `ctrl` and 4 more; runs `step` and `reset`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/tonyzhaozh__act --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/tonyzhaozh__act --backend fake --mcp
